acceptance.given: A governed skill fixture has a required declared section, declaration, or referenced section removed while remaining content is parseable.

oracle.expected: The validator rejects the fixture and emits a rule-specific diagnostic identifying the missing declaration or referenced section and its relative location.
forbidden: The validator accepts the fixture despite the missing required declaration or referenced section.
The validator checks headings only and omits the required rule and relative-location diagnostic.
oracle.observable: The validator result contains a rejection outcome and diagnostics naming the missing-section rule and relative location.

acceptance.then: The governed fixture is rejected with the required rule-specific relative-location diagnostic.
acceptance.when: The governed-fixture validator test runs against the mutated fixture.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the governed-fixture validator test with a required declaration or referenced section removed; observe whether validation accepts the fixture or fails to report the required rule and relative-location diagnostic.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce SM-A01 validation that governed fixtures containing missing required declarations or referenced sections are rejected with rule-specific relative-location diagnostics.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Validator behavior only; no persisted state or schema migration is required.

slice_hint.state_transition: Validation of a governed fixture with a missing required section transitions to an explicit rejection with diagnostic evidence.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The package validator test lane passes with rejection and rule/location diagnostics asserted for missing required declarations and referenced sections.
